title: Eventual equality of chain maps from two stages
statement: Let I be a directed preorder and F a diagram of commutative rings with colimit A [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix i₀ in I, and cochain complexes E₀ and K₀ of F(i₀)-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Assume E₀ is zero outside a finite interval and each term of E₀ and K₀ is finitely presented [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. For i and j at least i₀, let f be a chain map Eᵢ to Kᵢ and g a chain map Eⱼ to Kⱼ, with these complexes the termwise scalar extensions of E₀ and K₀. If their scalar extensions to A are equal, then there exists k at least both i and j where their scalar extensions are equal as chain maps. All these maps are transported by [def-pc-complex-scalar-extension-hom]. No homotopy or graded family is constructed.

source.place: Tag 09RE, affine proof of case (1), the finite number of finitely presented source terms; Algebra Tag 05N7, algebra-lemma-colimit-category-fp-modules

proof.text: Choose a stage l above i and j. Transport f and g to l with scalarExtensionHom. Mathlib ModuleCat.extendScalars_assoc, naturality of extendScalarsComp, and equality induction on the ring-map comparison witnesses show that iterated transport agrees with direct transport, both to the colimit and to any later stage. Thus the transported maps agree after extension to the colimit. Cancel the componentwise comparison isomorphisms to obtain equality of the extended component maps.

Scalar extension preserves finite presentation by the tensor-product finite-presentation instance. For each degree n in the finite interval [a,b], apply lem-pc-preorder-module-map-equality-descent to the two component maps at l. This gives a later stage where these component maps agree. That theorem supplies exactly the directed-preorder equality clause, including the antisymmetrization reduction.

Induct on the finite set of degrees. For the empty set take l. For an inserted degree choose a directed common upper bound of its detected stage and the stage for the previous finite set. Naturality of extendScalarsComp carries both equalities to this common stage. Conjugate the equal component maps by the scalar-extension comparisons. Outside [a,b], scalar extension preserves the zero source, so both components are equal. HomologicalComplex.hom_ext gives equality of the transported chain maps. The associativity calculation in the first step identifies them with direct transports of f and g to the final stage.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09RE, affine case (1), and 05N7 (3); explicit Lean scalar-extension coherence and finite-set induction by T1, using the existing preorder equality theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_perfect_chainMap_equality_detection
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (i₀ : I)
    (E₀ K₀ : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (F.obj i₀)) ℤ)
    (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (E₀.X n))
    (hEfp : ∀ n : ℤ, Module.FinitePresentation (F.obj i₀) (E₀.X n))
    (hKfp : ∀ n : ℤ, Module.FinitePresentation (F.obj i₀) (K₀.X n))
    (i : Set.Ici i₀)
    (j : Set.Ici i₀)
    (f : ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE i.property)).hom).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj E₀ ⟶
      ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE i.property)).hom).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj K₀)
    (g :
      ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj E₀ ⟶
          ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj K₀)
    (h : scalarExtensionHom (F.map (homOfLE i.property)).hom (colimit.ι F i.val).hom
        (colimit.ι F i₀).hom
        (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (colimit.w F (homOfLE i.property)).symm)
        E₀ K₀ f =
      scalarExtensionHom (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom (colimit.ι F j.val).hom
        (colimit.ι F i₀).hom
        (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (colimit.w F (homOfLE j.property)).symm)
        E₀ K₀ g) :
    ∃ (k : Set.Ici i₀) (hik : i ≤ k) (hjk : j ≤ k),
      scalarExtensionHom (F.map (homOfLE i.property)).hom (F.map (homOfLE hik)).hom
        (F.map (homOfLE k.property)).hom
        (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (F.map_comp
          (homOfLE i.property) (homOfLE hik))) E₀ K₀ f =
      scalarExtensionHom (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom (F.map (homOfLE hjk)).hom
        (F.map (homOfLE k.property)).hom
        (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (F.map_comp
          (homOfLE j.property) (homOfLE hjk))) E₀ K₀ g
